frase_gancho.texto: Two mountain peoples who turned death into art.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You are entering the Oaxaca hall, home of two peoples who made the mountain their home. About two thousand five hundred years ago, the Zapotecs flattened the top of a hill to build Monte Albán, and centuries later the Mixtecs arrived with gold, turquoise, and codices. Here, life is understood through death: ancestors rested beneath the floor of the house, in tombs with murals, and offerings were left for them. You will see a rain god, another of the night, stones that tell of wars, and tiny jewels made with almost unbelievable patience. And you will see how one people reopened the tomb of another. We begin at the beginning, with a stone that does not dance.
